name: Donchian channel position basket, 18 crypto spot pairs

rules.universe: 18 Binance USDT spot pairs with daily history from 2017 (list fixed before discovery; survivorship tested separately with 12 delisted pairs)
rules.score: position of the daily close inside the Donchian channel of the previous 55 closes (channel lagged one day), minus 0.5
rules.portfolio: cross-sectional basket built from the scores by the Monte-Neo alpha path, held for 7 days
rules.costs: spot fees and spread of the Monte-Neo crypto profile; the gate also uses doubled costs

data_manifest.note: the manifest lists every source file with its sha256; market data is not published here
